title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: This is a patched and re-tracked version of the previously circulating soundboard source shnid = 177

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard source captures a solid summer‑73 show with a standout Bird Song and clean, well‑balanced audio.
ai_review.review: The re‑tracked SBD version is praised as the best available source, delivering clear and balanced sound despite occasional audience patches. Fans describe the performance as very good, highlighting the beautiful Bird Song in the first set while noting no major musical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are positive (average 4.5★) and consistently praise both the performance and the soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Re‑tracked SBD version with a few audience patches; listeners note it sounds crisp, balanced, and superior to matrix or pure AUD sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall strong show that flows well; the first set’s Bird Song is highlighted as a high point.
